fix(mission): add terminal-state guard to Store.Update

Update had no c.Status != StatusOpen refusal, unlike every other
mutating operation (AppendResult, AppendReflection, AdvanceRound,
Close, Abandon), so a caller could resurrect a closed or abandoned
mission by setting Status back to open in its own copy of the
contract. The guard checks the on-disk status, not the caller's
proposed status, matching the sibling guards' error shape:
'mission %q is in terminal state %q; ...'.

Closes ethos-fhns.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <[redacted-email]>
EOF
)"
